description: List reported printer problems with their description, problem type, reporter, status and age — get_maintenance_dashboard returns only an open-problem count, none of this. Returns 10 per page by default; raise page_size (max 100) or advance page.

page_size.description: Problems per page, 1-100. Defaults to 10 over MCP.

printer_id.description: Only problems reported against this printer.

problem_type_id.description: Only problems of this problem type.

search.description: Substring match over problem description, printer name, problem type name and reporter name.

status.description: Filter by problem status. Use "open" for what still needs attention.

name: list_maintenance_problems
